issues.issue: Raw district sheet has no real header separation
issues.action: Used first row as header; kept all 175 raw rows for inspection

issues.issue: Junk rows from merged spreadsheet cells (satellite window labels glued into the district column)
Footnote/UN-disclaimer rows mixed into the data table
Province names appear as rows inside the district table (e.g. 'Balochistan', 'Azad Kashmir (2)')
issues.action: Marked them as province headers; districts below each inherit it

issues.issue: Row read as a province header but with no districts under it
issues.action: Treated 'Islamabad' as a district of itself
Took the MAXIMUM flood extent and exposed population across windows as the district's 'peak' value (documented, not hidden)
Rounded areas to 1 decimal, people to whole numbers
Left as blank (not filled with 0 — a blank means 'not measured')
Kept only the columns needed for the analysis

issues.issue: Column names are messy in the raw file
issues.action: Examples: column literally named 'PROVINCE ' (trailing space), 'IMPLEMENTNG PARTNER' (typo), 'GIRLS (0017 yrs)' (missing dash)

'PROVINCE ' values included: 'Sindh' (46233), 'Balochistan' (13667), 'SINDH' (10488), 'Khyber Pakhtunkhwa' (7099), 'Punjab' (6117), 'BALOCHISTAN' (2863), 'KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA' (2633), 'PUNJAB' (1812), 'GILGIT BALTISTAN' (134), '     SINDH' (25), 'balochistan' (8), 'Gilgit Baltistan' (7)

issues.issue: District column has case variants and non-district entries
issues.action: Examples: 'AWARAN' vs 'Awaran', 'CENTRAL KARACHI', 'CHITRAL LOWER'; normalised with the alias map

issues.issue: Non-numeric values in people targeted column
issues.action: Coerced to blank (NaN); treated as 0 in district sums

issues.issue: District column collapsed from raw variants to canonical districts
issues.action: Grouped 91k activity rows by canonical district

issues.issue: Districts with relief reports but no UNOSAT flood record
issues.action: Kept in the table (exposed_pop = 0); they are real places with real relief — the satellite assessment simply did not cover them

issues.issue: Flood-hit districts with NO relief rows in the 5W file
issues.action: Flagged as 'BIG GAP — no relief rows at all' — a core finding

issues.issue: Districts WITH relief rows but 0 beneficiaries reported (activities exist on paper, nobody counted as reached — e.g. Sialkot: 2 'Complete' activities, 0 beneficiaries)
issues.action: Flagged as 'BIG GAP — relief rows exist, 0 beneficiaries reported'
